comment: I wanted to thank Mayor Andy Mayor Beerman, Council Member Steve Council Member Joyce and Council Member Tim Council Member Henney for all their years of service to our community. I am proud of the work we have accomplished as a community with your leadership and am grateful for your commitment to our town's critical priorities. You have all been advocates for the environment and allies of Recycle Utah. I have truly enjoyed working with you.
